_comment: Timed on-screen messages for clip.html. Each key is a YouTube video ID — the 11 characters after v= in the address. 't' is seconds into the video (absolute, not relative to the clip start); each line stays up until the next one. The key must exactly match the ?v= value in the OptiSigns asset URL, or the video plays with no text.
